British Male Voice for Playmobil Pirate Ad

Need a fun and fearless pirate voice? I brought the high seas to life in this Playmobil promo! A swashbuckling performance with a playful twist, ideal for ads, toys, games, and more.

🦜 Aye, it’s a Playmobil Pirate!

Ahoy there! Playmobil wanted a bold, characterful pirate voice for their swashbuckling sea adventure, and I was more than happy to step aboard. This high-energy read needed a blend of classic pirate charm with a cheeky modern twist.

Watch the clip below and you’ll hear my signature pirate voice in action – perfect for children’s promos, games, and animations.

⚓ What made this project so fun?

Playmobil gave me creative freedom to let the pirate character truly shine. Think rumbling sea shanties, exaggerated "Arrrr!"s, and a sprinkle of comedy – the kind of performance that makes a toy advert memorable.

If you’re after something similar, whether it’s for toys, YouTube ads, or character games, my character voiceover work is where I thrive.


🏴‍☠️ Booking a pirate voice has never been easier

If you need a lively, fun, and unmistakably British pirate voice, you're in the right port. With over 100k scripts voiced, I’ve helped countless brands and creators find the perfect tone.

Explore more on my commercial voice page, or take a listen to my work with Lego Minifigures Pirate for another playful Pirate read.
